title.narrative: Accelerating Universal Access to Family Planning (AUAFP) - Shukhi Jibon Activity

description.narrative: (Bangladesh): The Accelerating Universal Access to Family Planning (AUAFP) activity will work with the GoB to increase access to and quality of family planning (FP) services to improve the contraceptive prevalence rate for modern methods, including long-acting reversible contraceptives. AUAFP will also help to address the reproductive health (RH) needs of adolescents and reduce the rate of adolescent pregnancies. With FY 2022 funds, USAID will implement AUAFP at the national level, with FP training institutes and public and private sector service providers in four divisions, covering half the country and focusing on the most in-need and vulnerable populations. AUAFP will improve the capacity of FP training institute trainers to use competency-based and adult learning approaches, teach supervisors to adopt mentorship and supportive supervision skills, and integrate adolescent care and gender into their training programs to expand the skills of health service providers. AUAFP will strengthen service readiness interventions by ensuring focus facilities meet the required standards to deliver quality FP and RH services. USAID will apply innovative demand-side approaches, including digital and social media, focused on adolescents and youth. The activity will increase the utilization and track the use of FP services by underserved groups, including ethnic and religious minorities, ready-made garment workers, and people with disabilities. AUAFP will address the underlying issues perpetuating gender-based violence and strengthen clinical services to care for survivors. This activity will contribute to the adaptation-indirect (FPRH-$300K) earmark.
